title: Congress Plays Keep-Away With Child’s School Lunch. “‘If you want to eat,...
content: Congress Plays Keep-Away With Child’s School Lunch. “‘If you want to eat, you’re going to have to jump for it!’ said Sen. Rand Paul (R-KY), laughing as he dangled the bag above the head of the 4-foot-tall child, who leapt in vain…”
author: Jason Kottke
